Women Advance Women Empowerment and Self-realization

Our Mission Our mission is to support enhance women professional and personal growth and fulfillment We are deeply committed to providing achievement-driven women with Inspiration, Guidance, and Networking

Our Target Audience Millennial women pursuing various careers ranging from art and fashion, to finance and politics;
Female professionals who have reached the middle management position and are struggling to break through the glass ceiling;
Women seeking a transition in order to fulfill their potential and receive recognition.

Our Approach We organize and conduct seminars with women speakers leaders in their industry TED Talks for Women in a seminar format We connect women with mentors in the industries of their interest

Topics of interest Sexual harassment Sexual abuse Negotiations/ salary and promotion negotiation skills Gender inequality, sexual discrimination, income disparity Women founders Communication challenges Conflict management skills for women Building leadership skills Obstacles in the way of success and the way to overcome them

First speakers Kathryn Ruemmler is an attorney who formerly served as White House Counsel to President Barack Obama. She previously worked as Principal Deputy White House Counsel Helen Fisher, PhD Biological Anthropologist, is a Senior Research Fellow, The Kinsey Institute, member of the Center for Human Evolutionary Studies in the Department of Anthropology, Rutgers University and Chief Scientific Advisor to the Internet dating site Match.com. She has conducted extensive research and written six books on the evolution and future of human sex, love, marriage, gender differences in the brain and how your personality style shapes who you are and who you love
Erika Karp is an American entrepreneur, businesswoman and investment advisor as well as a writer and speaker on issues related to sustainable finance. She is the Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Cornerstone Capital Inc., an investment firm Suzanne King is a partner at NEA, one of the largest and most successful Venture Capital companies in the United States.
Nell Derick Debovoise is the Founder & CEO of Inspiring Capital, a certified B Corp that powers purposeful growth with uniquely integrated training, consulting, and community offerings; Forbes contributor Arianna Huffington Karly Kloss
